在中央网信办指导下，中国网络空间安全协会会同国家互联网应急中心等单位，在前期发布: Under the guidance of the Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission, the China Internet Security Association, in conjunction with the National Internet Emergency Center and other units, building on the previous release of Chinese Internet Basic Corpus versions 1.0, 2.0, and 3.0, has established a mechanism for collaborative sharing of corpora through the AI Security Governance Special Committee of the cybersecurity association, consolidated a batch of new high-quality trustworthy data, and through a series of rigorous and meticulous data processing measures, developed and released to the public the Chinese Internet Basic Corpus 4.0 with a data volume of 120GB, providing trustworthy data support for large model training and artificial intelligence development.
